title: OpenAgentRulesAnchorProfile
description: Host anchor profile map. Declares, for each of the eight core anchor ids, the local anchor that implements it or that the host does not implement it. Normative: [OAR-PROF-2], [OAR-PROF-3].

oar_profile_version.description: OAR spec version this profile map targets.

core.description: Core anchor id → local anchor id implementing it.

unsupported.description: Core anchor ids this host does not implement. A rule targeting one is rejected at load.
